positive_cases.name: service_from_windows_temp
positive_cases.scenario: Service installed from the machine temporary directory.
positive_cases.rationale: Installation event and writable path selections both match.

positive_cases.name: service_from_public_directory
positive_cases.scenario: Service installed from the public profile directory.
positive_cases.rationale: Installation event and writable path selections both match.

negative_cases.name: managed_service_path
negative_cases.scenario: Service installed from a managed program directory.
negative_cases.rationale: Installation event matches but the path is not user writable.

negative_cases.name: service_start_failure_event
negative_cases.rationale: Path fragment matches but the event identifier is not a service installation.

negative_cases.name: driver_load_other_provider
negative_cases.scenario: Kernel filter driver reported by another provider.
negative_cases.rationale: Path fragment matches but the provider is not Service Control Manager.

notes: All events are synthetic. Negative cases are deliberate near misses that exercise one failing selection each.
